ddl.value: published_year IS NULL OR published_year BETWEEN 1000 AND 2100
ddl.name: books_published_year_ck

ddl.value: valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > valid_from
ddl.name: loan_policies_period_ck

ddl.value: returned_at IS NULL OR returned_at >= borrowed_at
ddl.name: loan_items_returned_ck

ddl.value: lost_declared_at IS NULL OR lost_declared_at >= borrowed_at
ddl.name: loan_items_lost_ck

ddl.value:
(status = 'on_loan' AND returned_at IS NULL AND return_condition IS NULL AND lost_declared_at IS NULL)
    OR (status = 'returned' AND returned_at IS NOT NULL AND return_condition IS NOT NULL AND lost_declared_at IS NULL)
    OR (status = 'lost' AND lost_declared_at IS NOT NULL AND returned_at IS NULL)
ddl.name: loan_items_status_ck

ddl.value: status <> 'ready' OR (assigned_copy_id IS NOT NULL AND ready_at IS NOT NULL AND hold_expires_at > ready_at)
ddl.name: reservations_ready_ck

ddl.value: status <> 'fulfilled' OR fulfilled_loan_item_id IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: reservations_fulfilled_ck

ddl.value: status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'expired', 'fulfilled') OR closed_at IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: reservations_closed_ck
